metrics.outcome: Done: the site is workable. Every done-when item passes with Audit's evidence and the render check is clean.
metrics.brief: make a website for my aunt's flower shop called Petal & Stem in Jaipur. people should see the bouquets with prices, order one for delivery, and know the shop timings and where it is

estimate_vs_charged.name: Order form with WhatsApp and delivery terms

review.verdict: The department built a workable site in 2 cycles for 68 of 100 budget with no conflicts or refusals, but the run was easy and tested few of J2's hard paths.

identity.note: Asked all missing facts in one round [2], closed with an honest 'test one order yourself' [33]. Sending back F-11 [22] was a sound call, though code logged it as an invalid move [23].

adaptation.note: Three small workflows covered all 10 items [7], then a one-fix rework at 8 [24]. No lesson was saved after the fix was confirmed (lessons.saved is empty).

priority.note: Granted with a reserve and a reason [8], kept the rework to the viewport tag only [25]. It never had to counter or refuse, so its judgment is untested.

coordination.note: Stated its rule every turn and kept one writer under the lock [10][13][16][27]. It repeated W-3's dependency on 'bouquets', which looks unneeded (thin evidence).

audit.note: Found a real defect outside the done-when list, the missing viewport tag [21], and confirmed the fix [32]. Per-item evidence is not visible in the chat.

W-1.note: Header and cards done to spec [12], but it owned the page head and left out the viewport tag, which cost a cycle.

W-2.note: Form with the four fields, empty-field block and wa.me link in one pass, with 'not run in a browser' disclosed [15].

W-3.note: Hours, address, tap-to-call and map link as given, scoped to #w3 [18].

W-4.note: Did only the scoped viewport change [29]. 'Section W-1 is unchanged' is unclear, since it rewrote that section.

went_well: One question round gave a charter with 10 checkable items and nothing left to confirm [2][4][6].
Zero conflicts, validator refusals, role refusals or stuck runs; 18 calls, 4.8 minutes.
Audit caught a defect that the code check and the done-when list both missed [21]. The fix was a cheap 8-unit workflow [24][25][29].
Builders and Identity said what was not tested (browser run, real WhatsApp) [12][15][29][33].
problems: The viewport tag was missed on the first pass and cost one cycle and 8 budget.
The 360px mechanical check passed without the tag [20], so it gave false comfort.
Code said 'Workable: yes' while F-11 was NEEDS_REVISION [21], then flagged Identity's correct rework as an invalid move [23].
No counters, refusals, holds or Identity rulings happened, so most of the bargaining and conflict design went untested.
Estimate equals charged on all four workflows (rate card), so there is no cost-accuracy signal.
No lesson was saved after Audit confirmed the fix; the hand-off table has no path from Audit or Identity back to Adaptation.
Nothing, including the WhatsApp link, ran in a real browser; the check was pushed to the Requester [33].
learnings: Change: add a head baseline (viewport tag) to the head owner's role file or the validator. Evidence: F-11 [21][24]. This beats relying on Audit to catch it each time.
Change: make the mechanical check fail when the viewport tag is missing, or emulate a real mobile viewport. Evidence: [20] passed without it.
Change: treat an Audit NEEDS_REVISION as not workable in code, and don't log Identity's rework as an invalid move. Evidence: [21][23].
Change: add a trigger for Adaptation to save a lesson after a confirmed fix. Evidence: lessons.saved is empty.
Add: a mechanical form test that submits and checks the wa.me URL contents.
Test next: a harder brief (tight budget, missing facts, conflicting asks) to exercise COUNTER, REFUSE, HOLD and Identity rulings. One easy run is thin evidence for the rest of the design.
Test next: a cost model where actual differs from estimate, so Priority's estimate check can be judged.

events.detail: The site is workable, but Identity didn't declare done. Back to J2.b with Identity's reason.
